name: Single-Leg Press
instructions: Sit in the leg press and place one foot flat in the middle of the platform, with the other leg off it.
Lower the platform until your knee is bent about 90 degrees.
Press through your heel to straighten your leg without locking out the knee.
Complete all reps, then switch legs.
image_prompt_scene: Seated in the leg press with one foot on the platform and the other leg off it.
